analyst.summary: Elgi Equipments is India's largest air-compressor manufacturer with a genuinely global manufacturing and distribution footprint. Revenue and profit are both growing at a moderate pace, with North America showing steady volume growth (despite some tariff-related margin pressure) and Europe still working through a turnaround toward breakeven. The stock trades at a rich valuation relative to its current growth rate. We rate this a Hold: a good, well-diversified business, but priced for more than the numbers currently show.
